app.help_item_4: PACS Viewer (4): Adjust contrast and brightness and report radiological exams.
app.help_item_5: SIFEN Tax (5): Generate electronic billing and automated XML invoices.
app.help_item_6: Financial Accounting (6): Add income and expenses and monitor cash flow.
app.help_item_7: Pharmacy / Stock (7): Monitor medications and handle dispensing.
app.help_item_8: Telemedicine (13): Enable integrated video consultations using the browser webcam.
app.help_footer: Developed under LGPD, CFM and SIFEN standards.
